36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
88113: An extremely fast and condescending shipgirl based on the real-life experimental Japanese destroyer Shimakaze. She's always seen either accompanied by or carrying one to three Rensouhou-chan, her robot mascots based on the 12.
88673: "The super-dreadnought fitted with Western technology at Vickers in England, Kongou has arrived! Even in the Pacific Theatre, I'll use the power of my speed to be of great use! Look forward to it!" - Kongou Kongou has long brown hair tied into buns on either side of her head.
88674: "I'm the fast battleship, Haruna. I was equipped with a set of four domestically made 36cm cannons. I stayed bravely watching the sky over Etajima village's naval base till the end. Haruna's last memory is of fighting as the last of the four fast battleship sisters.
88676: A cheerful, if often absent-minded, shipgirl based on the real-life Japanese cruiser Atago. Her sister ship is Takao. In the *Shimakaze Tsumujikaze no Shoujo* manga, she serves as Admiral Sumire Aosaki's secretary and turns down her romantic advances.
88677: "I'm Hiei, Kongou Onee-sama's sister. I'm looking forward to gaining experience and getting closer to my sister's brilliance." - Hiei "The battlecruiser that Admiral Inoue loved, it's Hiei. Even though I'm a shiny Imperial ship, I'll work my hardest.
88678: One of Kongou's sister ships. Based on the real-life Japanese battleship Kirishima. In episode 6 of the first anime, she serves as the curry contest's announcer.
88816: "I am Fubuki, the first ship of the special type destroyers, designed under the Washington Naval Treaty, that were beyond existing ship classification and shocked the world. Based on our design, a lot of following fleet-type destroyers were built. Yes sir, I'll do my best!
88828: "The first Imperial Navy destroyer to be loaded with the powerful large-type 61cm torpedoes, Mutsuki! While I'm a old model, I'll give it my all on the front!"
88829: A carefree and cheerful shipgirl based on the real-life Japanese destroyer Yuudachi. She has a habit of randomly exclaiming "っぽい" ("poi"), as well as integrating it into her sentences (oftentimes at the end).
134668: A calm and no-nonsense bow-wielding shipgirl based on the real-life Japanese aircraft carrier Kaga. Sister ship to Akagi.
154018: A shipgirl stationed at the Truk Lagoon forward base during Operation FS, said to be the most powerful battleship ever built. She's also a great chef, serving luxurious home-cooked meals to Fubuki and friends upon their meeting.
172233: The most bubbly and outgoing of all the Sendai-class sisters, even going so far as to proclaiming herself as the fleet's idol.
174620: Nagato serves as the Admiral's Secretary Ship with Mutsu always alongside her. She is calm and collected and carries a serious, intimidating air about her wherever she goes, making sure the other fleet girls abide by the Navy's rules.
174621: Zuikaku wears a shortened miko uniform with arm bracers and thigh boots with propellers protruding from them. Like most archer carriers, she wields a bow, and wears a muneate. Her muneate has the katakana ス (su), which when voiced becomes ズ (zu), the first kana of Zuikaku's name.
174622: Akagi has long brown hair flowing down straightly. She wears a chest protector (muneate) over white and red clothes and wields a bow and arrows.
174729: "I'm Akatsuki! Treat me like the fully-fledged lady that I am! "
196078: "If you're talking about cruisers, no matter how you look at it, it has to be me, Takao! Attached to Vice Admiral Kondo's 4th fleet, I participated in many naval battles. Overcoming these hard-fought conflicts, I concluded with a diligent defence of Singapore."
291904: Shigure is a Shiratsuyu-class destroyer. She has a black serafuku like her sisters, and in the anime appears as her "Kai Ni" version from the game. She is in the 1st Striking Force 3rd Section.
300535: "I'm the Mutsuki-class destroyer, Mochizuki. As part of the 30th Destroyer Division, I participated in every invasion operation. I kept doing transport missions while going through many repairs. I worked hard right?"
300536: "I'm the 3rd ship of the Mutsuki-class destroyers, Yayoi. I was born in Uraga, Yokosuka. I worked hard doing lots of things in a fleet with Mutsuki and Mochizuki. I hate bombers. Take care of me."
